title: SRE Connector: weekly pulse & operator log — 2027-09-07
content:
----
Date: 2027-09-07
Author: Aisha Patel (on-call rotation)
Attendees: Aisha Patel (oncall), Marco Rivera (SRE lead), Leah Kim (infra), Owen Fitzgerald (serving-runtime), Priya Narang (product)
----
TL;DR
- Quiet week for customer-visible incidents: one P2 timeout on 2027-09-05 caused short-lived degradation for Dedicated customers in us-west1; corrected by autoscaler tuning and a hotfix to the batching logic.
- SLO health is stable but error budget for 'generation success rate' is at 78% for the quarter — schedule regression tests for the newer quantized model variants.
- On-call handoffs: improve runbook entry for 'kv cache warm failures' and add a diagnostic dashboard tile (see action item 3).

Incidents (summary)
1) P2 - request timeouts (2027-09-05 14:12–14:55 UTC)
   - Impact: ~2.1% of requests to model-runs in us-west1 returned a 504 or timed out; Dedicated tier customers most affected.
   - Root cause: regressions in batching window selector after last week's batching PR (SERVE-3123) combined with lower-than-expected pod capacity during a rolling upgrade.
   - Mitigation: rolled back PR -> immediate reduction in timeouts; patched batching selector to respect capacity signals -> redeployed at 14:40; autoscaler config bumped to ensure minimum pool during upgrades.
   - Post-incident steps: runbook addendum (see linked artifact), retrospective scheduled for 2027-09-09.

2) P3 - ephemeral redis connection errors (2027-09-03 02:30–03:10 UTC)
   - Impact: transient slowdowns for internal cache rehydration tasks; no customer-facing errors.
   - Notes: caused by misconfigured client TLS rotation during maintenance window. Fixed by rotating clients in sequence; patch to client lib to better surface TLS handshake errors.

SLO / Metrics snapshot
- Generation success rate (target 99.5%): current quarter 98.3% (error budget remaining: 78%). Trend: small downward slope last two weeks.
- p99 latency (hosted API): 1.12s (above target 1.0s) largely due to increased long-tail with sequence length spikes.
- Errors by class: batching-induced timeouts (54%), transient infra errors (22%), model loading failures (24%).
- Action: schedule a p99 deep-dive w/ serving-runtime + ML infra to check kernel selection heuristics for long sequences (owner: Owen, due 2027-09-14).

Capacity and scaling notes
- Autoscaler tweak deployed during incident: min-replicas enforced during rolling upgrades to avoid under-capacity.
- Capacity projections for next 30 days look OK but monitor for spike from beta customer (Acme.ai) starting 2027-09-12.
- Temporary mitigation: reserve a small warm pool in us-west1 for Dedicated customers during beta windows (proposal in progress).

Runbooks / Playbook changes
- Added 'batch-window-regression' checklist: detection queries, immediate rollback steps, and owner escalation path.
- Need a clearer 'kv cache warm failures' diagnostic flow (missing: how to check cache TTL skew across pods). Owner: Leah (PR by 2027-09-10).
- Update: 'redis-tls-rotation' steps updated to include sequential client rotation and explicit health-checks before next client restart.

On-call handoff (notes for next shift)
- State: Oncall has open incident tracker ticket SRE-4521 (see linked). Rolling upgrade completed; watch latency for next 12 hours.
- Known flakiness: one Dedicated customer report queued (internal ticket SVC-889) — follow-up with Solutions Eng (Priya).
- Handoff checklist items:
   1) Confirm deploys finished and no pending rollbacks
   2) Check 'generation success rate' dashboard and p99 tile
   3) Ensure autoscaler group min-replicas still set
   4) Verify new runbook patches are in latest doc

Action items
- Aisha: Postmortem draft for P2 timeout (initials + timeline) — due 2027-09-09.
- Marco: Coordinate p99 latency deep-dive with ML infra and serving-runtime; prepare kernel-selection sample traces — due 2027-09-14.
- Leah: PR for 'kv cache warm failures' diagnostic flow + unit tests — due 2027-09-10.
- Owen: Add a dashboard tile showing 'batching window selector decisions' (heatmap) — due 2027-09-16.
- Priya: Customer outreach plan for Dedicated beta (Acme.ai) and escalation points — due 2027-09-11.

Risks & open questions
- Are we comfortable with the current autoscaler min-replica policy across regions during upgrades? (ops risk vs. cost). Need a policy decision by product/infra.
- Quantized model variants show slight quality drift in evaluations — should we shift traffic away during the next 24/72-hour window? (ML + Product decision)

Meeting notes & decisions
- Short sync (09/06): decided to enforce min-replicas during control-plane-initiated upgrades; product will reimburse a modest capacity allocation for Dedicated beta.
- Agreed to start a weekly cross-team 'long-tail latency' meeting (serving-runtime + applied-ml + infra) starting 2027-09-14.

Attachments / Links
- Incident ticket: https://rdw.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-4521
- Runbook updates: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/ops-playbook-v2
- Slack thread (ops): slack:#sre-ops-thread-zn9h2

Quick notes to self
- Keep an eye on the heatmap Owen will add — should make debugging batching issues much faster.
- During handoffs, highlight any deviation from normal deploy cadence (even small ones) — pattern recognition helps.

----
End of log
----
